description: This file defines extension methods for the StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> class in the Orleans.Streams namespace, providing various overloads of ResumeAsync to facilitate stream subscription management using delegates and batch observers.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for StreamSubscriptionHandle<T> to resume stream consumption with various delegate configurations.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Multiple overloads of ResumeAsync to resume stream consumption with different delegate handlers, supporting both individual and batch observers, with optional stream sequence tokens.
